verdict.rationale: monday.com offers built-in AI agents that can be messaged, assigned items, and @mentioned to perform real work directly within the product ('Talk to agents like teammates... assign them items'), with docs describing creating custom agents via natural language and managing them from an admin dashboard. Community evidence is generic product criticism unrelated to the AI assistant feature, so it doesn't dispute this capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of agent quality/reliability and no third-party review of the assistant feature specifically.
